motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to approve the Consent Agenda with the spelling corrections to the minutes as discussed during the work session . Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved with minutes corrections
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, including spelling corrections to the meeting minutes discussed earlier in the work session.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — this is the routine batch approval of items the council did not need to debate.

motions.item_title: Approve a Resolution Approving the Disposal of 0.156 Acres of Designated “Significant Real Prop…
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve a Resolution Approving the Disposal of 0.156 Acres of Designated “Significant Real Property” (Utah County Parcel No. 49:601:0080) Pursuant to EMMC 3.30.060 and 3.30.070 with the following amendments to the original agreement: 1. Extend the completion timeline to one year. 2. Remove requirement for Lot 63 to participate in the agreement and allow the remaining property owners to proceed. Councilmember Huish seconded the motion.
motions.headline: City sells 0.156 acres to neighboring property owners
motions.summary: The council approved disposing of 0.156 acres of city-owned land, gave the buyers a year to finish, and dropped one lot from the deal.
motions.impact: This touches only the handful of adjoining property owners in the agreement, who now have a year to complete the transfer. One lot no longer has to take part.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.20 (Preliminary Plats ), 16.25 (Final P lats), and 17.100 (Site Plan Review ) regarding Application Requirements
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.20 (Preliminary Plats ), 16.25 (Final P lats), and 17.100 (Site Plan Review ) regarding Application Requirements. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New paperwork rules for subdivision and site plans
motions.summary: The council updated what developers must submit when applying for preliminary plats, final plats, and site plan review.
motions.impact: This affects builders and developers filing applications with the city. If you're not submitting development plans, nothing changes for you.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 8.15.070 (Noise Levels) as presented
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 8.15.070 (Noise Levels) as presented . Councilmember Huish seconded the motion. Councilmember Whiting withdrew the motion.
motions.headline: Noise rule change withdrawn in favor of revised version
motions.summary: A motion to adopt the noise ordinance as originally written was withdrawn before any vote was taken.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — the council set this version aside and took up an amended one instead.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 8.15.070 (Noise Levels) , with the following redline amendment : the time under (D)(2) Golf Course be revised to 10:00 p.m. to 5:30 a.m
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 8.15.070 (Noise Levels) , with the following redline amendment : the time under (D)(2) Golf Course be revised to 10:00 p.m. to 5:30 a.m . Councilmember Huish seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Golf course noise allowed to start at 5:30 a.m.
motions.summary: The council changed the city's noise rules so golf course maintenance noise is restricted only between 10 p.m. and 5:30 a.m.
motions.impact: If you live near the golf course, crews can legally start mowing and maintenance at 5:30 in the morning. Everyone else sees no change.

motions.headline: Triumph subdivision deal adds 53 affordable homes
motions.summary: The council approved a revised Triumph development agreement covering 53 units in one section of Plat 2, with fencing, water-wise landscaping and full appliances required.
motions.impact: If you're buying in the Triumph subdivision, the affordable homes in that pod must be owner-occupied and come with appliances and landscaping included. Water-rate help for the project lasts only while redevelopment funds hold out.

motions.item_title: Add working with Best Friends Animal Society on the various resources presented to the Legislat…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to add working with Best Friends Animal Society on the various resources presented to the Legislative Priorities List. Councilmember Huish seconded the motion .
motions.headline: Add animal-shelter resources to state lobbying list
motions.summary: The council added working with Best Friends Animal Society on animal-related resources to the city's list of legislative priorities.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents now — this only sets what city staff will raise with state lawmakers on animal issues.
